info.title: AutoMapSharp migration tool
info.description: A .NET tool that rewrites AutoMapper code to AutoMapSharp across a whole folder. Run it with --dry-run first to see every change it would make, then run it for real and review the diff. The migration guide covers the few things it cannot convert automatically.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview migrations without writing changes to disk.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show command-line help and usage instructions.
Rules Migrated:
* AMSMIG001: 'using AutoMapper;' -> 'using AutoMapSharp;'
* AMSMIG002: ': Profile' -> ': MappingModule'
* AMSMIG003: 'CreateMap<T, U>()' -> 'DefineMap<T, U>()'
* AMSMIG004: '.ForMember(...)' -> '.ForProperty(...)'
* AMSMIG005: '.MapFrom(...)' -> '.MapSource(...)'
* AMSMIG006: '.Ignore()' -> '.Skip()'
* AMSMIG007: '.ProjectTo<T>()' -> '.ProjectOnto<T>()'
* AMSMIG008: 'IMapper' -> 'IMapEngine'
* AMSMIG009: '.Condition(...)' -> '.If(...)'
* AMSMIG010: '.NullSubstitute(...)' -> '.Fallback(...)'
* AMSMIG011: 'IValueResolver<...>' -> 'IPropertyResolver<...>'
* AMSMIG005: '.MapFrom<TResolver>()' -> '.MapWith<TResolver>()'
* AMSMIG007: 'ProjectTo<T>(mapper.ConfigurationProvider)' -> 'ProjectOnto<T>(mapper)'

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Target directory or file path to migrate (defaults to current directory).
